how we work

A process that doesn't end at launch

Most agency processes stop at delivery. Ours has a fifth step for a reason — that's where the dedicated-assistant model actually kicks in.

01

Discovery call

We talk through what you're trying to build, grow, or support — no pitch deck, just questions specific to your project. This usually surfaces which of our four service areas actually apply.

02

Scope & proposal

We come back with a concrete scope, timeline, and pricing model — fixed-scope, retainer, or staff augmentation, whichever fits the project. No vague "let's discuss further" loops.

03

Design & architecture

For builds, this means data modeling and system design before any code. For marketing, it means positioning and channel strategy before any campaign spend. We don't skip this step to look faster.

04

Build & launch

Regular check-ins, not a black-box build followed by a surprise reveal. You'll see progress throughout, not just at the end.

05

Managed support

Once live, you're handed to a dedicated assistant who already has full context on the project — for ongoing updates, fixes, and small requests, without re-explaining everything to someone new.
